# swarmops ws list

List the store's workspaces.

```yaml
title: "swarmops ws list"
description: "List the store's workspaces."
group: "workspaces"
since: "0.3.0"
mutates: false
identity_required: false
mcp_tool: "ws_list"
envelope_op: "ws_list"
exit_codes: [0]
errors: []
syntax: "swarmops ws list [OPTIONS]"
```

## Syntax

```text
swarmops ws list [OPTIONS]
```

## Required arguments

None.

## Optional arguments

The command also takes the [global options](../cli.md#global-options).

### `--check`

Syntax: `--check`.

Also open each, and report one whose directory is gone as an orphan.

## Return information

`result` is a `WsList` (`swarmops schema WsList` prints its JSON Schema).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspaces` | `array of WsInfo` | yes | The workspaces. |

Envelope `op`: `ws_list`.

Exit codes:

- `0`: Success.

## Errors

No golden step shows this command failing yet.

Any command that opens a store may also fail with a store error, such as [`E_NOT_A_REPO`](../errors.md#e_not_a_repo), [`E_IO`](../errors.md#e_io) or [`E_STORE_CORRUPT`](../errors.md#e_store_corrupt); a command line the grammar refuses is [`E_INVALID_ARG`](../errors.md#e_invalid_arg) (exit 2).
